requirements.text: В списке продуктов отображается название поставщика, и пользователь может фильтровать продукты по поставщику.
notes: This slice starts from a successful product supplier selection baseline: Product already has optional supplier_id and product create/edit can select an existing supplier.

Supplier records must already be available through /api/suppliers or existing schema-compatible mock storage from previous slices; this slice should not recreate supplier management or change the Supplier schema.

Browser/e2e should use supplier ids/names that actually exist in the current suppliers API response or created runtime test data; do not hardcode supplier labels that are not guaranteed by the current baseline.
